profile.name: Umar Razzaq
profile.headline:
Building worlds.
Engineering experiences.
profile.intro: I build responsive gameplay, intelligent AI, and multiplayer experiences in Unreal Engine. From the first prototype to production-ready systems, I turn ambitious ideas into games that feel great to play.

about.heading:
A developer’s mindset.
A player’s curiosity.
about.body:
I’m an Unreal Engine developer specializing in C++ and Blueprint. My work spans AA and indie games, multiplayer frameworks, smart AI systems, real-time visualization, and tools that help teams create faster.

I enjoy the space where creative ambition meets technical problem-solving: making a mechanic feel responsive, giving AI purpose, or finding a cleaner way to build a complex system.

services.title: Gameplay development
services.description: Responsive mechanics, character systems, combat, and gameplay abilities built with clean C++ and Blueprint architecture.

services.title: AI & behavior systems
services.description: Intelligent enemies, coordinated squads, boss behaviors, and adaptive encounters using Behavior Trees and EQS.

services.title: Multiplayer systems
services.description: Replication, authority management, listen-server frameworks, and connected gameplay that performs reliably.

services.title: Tools & plugins
services.description: Custom editor utilities, production plugins, and Python automation that reduce repetitive work and speed up iteration.

services.title: Performance optimization
services.description: Profiling, memory management, and targeted optimization to keep complex experiences responsive across platforms.

services.title: UI & interactive experiences
services.description: UMG interfaces, real-time architectural visualization, and AI-powered interactions with MetaHuman and connected APIs.

contact.heading: Let’s build something worth playing.
contact.intro: Have a project in mind, need help with a technical challenge, or want to talk games? I’d love to hear from you.
